summary: Across 10 complete synthetic repeats in two deterministic configurations, the default consistent_random partitioner delivered the fixed key to partition 30 in all five repeats and murmur2_random delivered it to partition 2 in all five, each equal to the partition computed from the pinned librdkafka v2.16.0 algorithms for a 32-partition event hub, so H_partition holds and the proposed B08 verdict is confirmed.
An independent consumer read back the same topic, partition, offset, key and value in every repeat, and each producer and reader reported partition IDs exactly 0 to 31 in its own metadata.

One key, one event hub of 32 partitions and one producer message per repeat were tested; behaviour for other keys, other partition counts, keyless messages and the sticky and random partitioners was not.
